title: Heat Network KPI Reference
subtitle: Generated from the platform's KPI registry. A working basis for a proposed British Standard on heat network key performance indicators.
intro: One table per element type, in network order from the energy centre to the dwelling. The layout follows the KPI tables of the HNTAS Milestone 4 technical specifications so the two can be compared row by row; the columns that differ carry the detail a KPI needs to be computed the same way on every network.
legend: `<element>-KPI-<nn>`; a letter after the number is a variant (A reported form, B weather-compensated or per-source form). `-C-` marks the cooling form of a KPI; `-M-` a meter-health KPI; `-H-` a health KPI (hours below outage limits, offered as an alternative to the outage KPIs 04 and 05).

**HNTAS**: in the HNTAS Milestone 4 specifications, assessed (pass/fail) or reported (expected value only). **HNTAS-style**: an HNTAS KPI's method applied where the scheme does not yet reach, such as cooling. **Heatweb**: a diagnostic KPI the platform runs that HNTAS does not define. **proposed**: defined here, not yet computed by the platform.
Point code, minimum data frequency, and the fields read. "x, else y" is a fallback chain: the first source with data at each reading is used.
Pass criterion for an assessed KPI; "expected value" for a reported one. "(proposed)" marks a value put forward for review.
The maths, in as few words as states it exactly.
The window the KPI is assessed over.
notation: tF, tR flow and return temperature (°C); q volumetric flow rate (m³/h); V volume register (m³); E energy register (kWh); ΔE, ΔV register increase over the period or day; 1.163 kWh/(m³·K) the volumetric heat capacity of water; Σ over the period; n readings. Volume weighting pairs readings in 5-minute buckets. Data at a higher frequency than the minimum is used at that frequency.
rules: Readings that fail the out-of-range bounds for their channel are excluded before any KPI is computed. A setpoint input follows the live setpoint stream where the controls publish one and falls back to the design value where they do not. Consumer Connection KPIs 01 to 03 are assessed across all consumer connections together, not dwelling by dwelling.

rows.title: Energy Centre ARMS connectivity
rows.monitoring: all EC points
rows.calc: received intervals ÷ expected intervals across connected points

rows.title: Energy Centre monitoring point data completeness
rows.monitoring: all EC points
rows.calc: valid readings ÷ expected readings

rows.title: Energy Centre monitoring points operational
rows.monitoring: all EC points
rows.calc: points with no error/negative/out-of-range values ÷ total points

rows.title: Energy Centre unplanned interruptions
rows.monitoring: EC · tF (sensor, else heat meter); sensor dP
rows.calc: count of >12h periods below min flow temp OR min dP without 48h notice. Uses design/minFlowTemp design/minDPIndex

rows.title: Energy Centre planned interruptions
rows.monitoring: EC · tF (sensor, else heat meter); sensor dP
rows.calc: count of noticed (≥48h) interruptions. Uses design/minFlowTemp design/minDPIndex

rows.title: Energy Centre average flow temperature
rows.monitoring: EC · tF (sensor, else heat meter)
rows.calc: time-weighted mean of flow temperature. Uses design/tF

rows.title: Energy Centre average return temperature
rows.monitoring: EC · tR (sensor, else heat meter)
rows.calc: time-weighted mean of return temperature

rows.title: EC flow temperature variance from set point
rows.monitoring: EC · tF (sensor, else heat meter), tF (setpoint, else design)
rows.calc: mean |tF - setpoint|

rows.title: EC volume weighted average flow temperature (VWAFT)
rows.monitoring: EC · tF (heat meter, else sensor); heat meter m³/h
rows.calc: Σ(tF · flow volume) ÷ Σ(volume). Uses design/tF

rows.title: EC VWAFT (weather-compensated variant)
rows.monitoring: EC · tF (heat meter, else sensor), tF (setpoint, else design); heat meter m³/h
rows.calc: as 09A against live setpoint

rows.title: EC flow temperature stability
rows.monitoring: EC · tF (sensor, else heat meter), tF (setpoint, else design)
rows.calc: 1 - (time above upper + below lower) ÷ total

rows.title: EC flow temperature stability (weather-compensated)
rows.monitoring: EC · tF (sensor, else heat meter), tF (setpoint, else design)
rows.calc: as 10A against compensated setpoint

rows.title: EC flow temperature uptime
rows.monitoring: EC · tF (sensor, else heat meter)
rows.threshold: ≥ 98% above minimum flow temp (99.5% at M4)
rows.calc: time above minimum ÷ total time. Uses design/minFlowTemp

rows.title: EC pressure differential uptime
rows.monitoring: EC · sensor dP
rows.calc: time above minimum dP ÷ total. Uses design/minDPIndex

rows.title: Max allowable differential pressure exceedance
rows.monitoring: EC · sensor dpSupply
rows.calc: 1 - time above max dP ÷ total. Uses design/maxDPSupply

rows.title: Max allowable operating pressure exceedance
rows.monitoring: EC · sensor pressure
rows.calc: 1 - time above max pressure ÷ total. Uses design/maxPressure

rows.title: Top-up water volume
rows.monitoring: EC · water meter m³
rows.threshold: ≤ 1% of system volume per month (0.17% at M4/TS1)
rows.calc: make-up volume ÷ system volume per month. Uses design/systemVolume

rows.title: Heat fraction (source A)
rows.monitoring: EC · heat meter kWh
rows.calc: source A heat out ÷ total heat out

rows.title: Heat fraction (source B)
rows.monitoring: EC · heat meter kWh
rows.calc: source B heat out ÷ total heat out

rows.title: Network distribution pump energy
rows.monitoring: EC · electricity meter kwhElectric
rows.calc: sum of distribution pump electricity (excl. shunts). Uses design/kwhAnnualPump

rows.title: Energy Centre hours below outage limits
rows.monitoring: EC · tF (sensor, else heat meter); sensor dpIndex
rows.threshold: < 60 h a year, judged on the month pro rata (≈ 4.9 h in 30 days); shorter windows report hours used
rows.calc: Σ_i min(t_{i+1} − t_i, 1 h) over readings with tF < tF_min or dP < dP_min; tF and dP spans unioned. Offered as an alternative to KPI-04/05. Uses design/minFlowTemp design/minDPIndex

rows.title: Heat generation efficiency (source A)
rows.monitoring: EC · heat meter kWh; gas meter m3Gas, kWh
rows.threshold: gas/oil 80% · biomass 75% · electric 98% · heat pump COP 2.0 · CHP QI 105
rows.calc: heat out ÷ fuel in (boiler gross; HP CoP uses emeter). Uses design/efficiency

rows.title: Heat generation efficiency (source B)
rows.monitoring: EC · heat meter kWh; gas meter m3Gas, kWh; electricity meter kwhElectric
rows.threshold: gas/oil 80% · biomass 75% · electric 98% · heat pump COP 2.0 · CHP QI 105
rows.calc: as 17-A per source. Uses design/efficiency

rows.title: Consumer Connection ARMS connectivity (aggregated)

rows.title: Consumer Connection data completeness (aggregated)
rows.monitoring: all CC points

rows.title: Consumer Connection monitoring points operational (aggregated)
rows.monitoring: all CC points
rows.calc: points with no error/negative/out-of-range values ÷ total points (two-stage; ALL heat-meter channels tF tR m³ q kW kWh)

rows.title: Consumer Connection unplanned interruptions
rows.monitoring: CC1 · 30 min · tF (heat meter, else sensor)
rows.calc: count of unplanned interruptions (≥ 12 h below minimum flow temp)

rows.title: Consumer Connection planned interruptions
rows.monitoring: CC1 · 30 min · tF (heat meter, else sensor)
rows.calc: count of planned interruptions (≥ 12 h below minimum flow temp)

rows.monitoring: CC1 · 30 min · tF (heat meter, else sensor)
rows.calc: heat generated at the CC ÷ energy input to the CC

rows.monitoring: CC1 · 30 min · tR (heat meter, else sensor); heat meter m³/h
rows.calc: Σ(tR · q) ÷ Σ(q) by 5-min buckets

rows.title: Consumer Connection average return temperature (reported)
rows.monitoring: CC1 · 30 min · tR (heat meter, else sensor)
rows.calc: time-average of tR

rows.title: Consumer Connection volume-weighted average temperature difference (VWATD)
rows.monitoring: CC1 · 30 min · heat meter kWh, m³
rows.threshold: ≥ 5 °C (pair: CC-07 or CC-08 must be met)
rows.calc: kWh register delta ÷ (1.163 · m³ register delta)

rows.title: Consumer Connection cooling ARMS connectivity (aggregated)
rows.monitoring: CC1 · all cooling meter channels
rows.calc: Σ intervals received ÷ Σ intervals expected, all cooling CC points combined

rows.title: Consumer Connection cooling data completeness (aggregated)
rows.monitoring: CC1 · all cooling meter channels
rows.calc: Σ valid readings ÷ Σ expected readings, all cooling CC points combined

rows.title: Consumer Connection cooling monitoring points operational (aggregated)
rows.monitoring: CC1 · 30 min · cooling meter kWh, m³, m³/h, kW, tF, tR
rows.calc: points with no error, negative or out-of-range value ÷ points connected with complete data (C-01, C-02); every cooling-meter channel

rows.title: Consumer Connection cooling unplanned interruptions
rows.monitoring: CC1 · 30 min · cooling meter tF
rows.calc: count of unplanned periods ≥ 12 h with chilled flow tF > maximum chilled flow temperature. Uses design/tFMaxCool (proposed)

rows.title: Consumer Connection cooling planned interruptions
rows.monitoring: CC1 · 30 min · cooling meter tF
rows.calc: count of planned periods ≥ 12 h with chilled flow tF > maximum chilled flow temperature. Uses design/tFMaxCool (proposed)

rows.title: Consumer Connection cooling volume-weighted average return temperature
rows.monitoring: CC1 · 30 min · cooling meter tR, m³/h
rows.threshold: ≥ design cooling return − 2 °C (proposed; pair: C-07 or C-08 must be met)
rows.calc: Σ(tR · q) ÷ Σ q over 5-minute buckets. Uses design/tRCool (proposed)

rows.title: Consumer Connection cooling average return temperature (reported)
rows.monitoring: CC1 · 30 min · cooling meter tR
rows.calc: Σ tR ÷ n (time average)

rows.title: Consumer Connection cooling volume-weighted average temperature difference
rows.monitoring: CC1 · 30 min · cooling meter kWh, m³
rows.threshold: ≥ 4 °C (proposed; pair: C-07 or C-08 must be met)
rows.calc: ΔT = ΔE ÷ (1.163 · ΔV); ΔE, ΔV = register deltas over the period (kWh, m³)

rows.title: Meter reporting (not silent)
rows.monitoring: CC1 · 30 min · heat meter kWh; cooling meter kWh
rows.threshold: last reading within 72 h of period end
rows.calc: a reading on every meter within the last 72 h of the period

rows.title: Meter channel coverage
rows.monitoring: CC1 · 30 min · heat meter kWh, m³, m³/h, kW, tF, tR
rows.calc: channels with ≥ 1 reading among kWh, m³, m³/h, kW, tF, tR (the fewest on any of the dwelling’s meters)

rows.title: Meter reading cadence
rows.monitoring: CC1 · 30 min · heat meter kWh; cooling meter kWh
rows.calc: energy-register readings ÷ days in period

rows.title: Register integrity
rows.monitoring: CC1 · 30 min · heat meter kWh; cooling meter kWh
rows.calc: days with ΔE < 0 (register stepped back) or ΔE > 500 kWh (implausible jump), all the dwelling’s meters

rows.title: Plausible temperature difference
rows.monitoring: CC1 · 30 min · heat meter kWh, m³; cooling meter kWh, m³
rows.calc: ΔT = ΔE ÷ (1.163 · ΔV) within bounds; outside = scaling, units or a replaced meter

rows.title: Flow comes to rest (no constant flow)
rows.monitoring: CC1 · 30 min · heat meter m³/h; cooling meter m³/h
rows.calc: readings with q = 0 ÷ all q readings, per meter (needs ≥ 6 readings); below target = flow never at rest: bypass or control fault

rows.title: No low temperature difference at volume
rows.monitoring: CC1 · 30 min · heat meter kWh, m³; cooling meter kWh, m³
rows.threshold: heat: not (ΔT < 5 °C and > 150 L/day); cooling: not (ΔT < 2 °C and > 1,000 L/day)
rows.calc: ΔT = ΔE ÷ (1.163 · ΔV); L/day = 1000 · ΔV ÷ days

rows.title: No simultaneous heating and cooling
rows.monitoring: CC1 · 30 min · heat meter kWh; cooling meter kWh
rows.calc: days with heat ΔE > 0.5 kWh and cooling ΔE > 0.5 kWh ÷ days with either

rows.title: Load follows demand (no flat load)
rows.monitoring: CC1 · 30 min · heat meter kWh
rows.calc: CV = σ ÷ μ of daily heat ΔE over ≥ 7 days, applied when μ > 2 kWh/day; below target = constant load: control fault

rows.title: Consumption band (reported)
rows.monitoring: CC1 · 30 min · heat meter kWh, m³; cooling meter kWh, m³
rows.threshold: low: < 2 kWh/day and < 40 L/day; high: > max(15 kWh/day, 2 × site median)
rows.calc: daily ΔE and ΔV compared with the site's median dwelling

rows.title: Cooling offset by heating (24 h overlap)
rows.monitoring: CC1 · 30 min · heat meter kWh; cooling meter kWh
rows.threshold: expected value (reported; site-wide figure on the combined element)
rows.calc: Σ_d min(ΔE_heat,d, ΔE_cool,d) ÷ Σ_d ΔE_cool,d over the period's days
